Dialog: Ja!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, listen up, ladies. The Mayor has tasked us, Troop 46231, with baking the official droogen strudel for the tasting today. The key to making droogen strudel is the raisin-like dried doonkelberries called the droogen. Now, there are going to be actual Drusselsteinian emissaries here at the fair. And these emissaries are real sticklers about their droogen strudel, so no distractions. Every fiber of our full attention must be laser-focused on this task! I wonder what Phineas and Ferb are up to.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: I present to you the world's largest doonkelberry!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wow! I never thought the process of growin' a berry that big would be so disgusting!

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOOOOOOOM!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: The droogen folks will love it! Now we just have to get it there.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It seems too heavy for an airlift. Perhaps if we had two trucks attached side by side...

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Or we could just roll it there.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Now those are some transportational logistics that I can get behind!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (scoffs) "Two trucks attached side by side." How foolish could I be?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: C'mon, c'mon, c'mon!...And back in the house we go.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, Doofenshmirtz has been spotted at Droogenfest. He's probably just there to celebrate.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Or he could try to interfere with the droogen strudel tasting! Our entire economy depends on establishing trade with the Drusselsteinians!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Seriously?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes! If anything goes wrong, the Tri-State Area may have to sell off one of the state areas!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Leaving just a Bi-State Area? (shudders, to Agent P) Whatta ya waitin' for, Agent P?! Go after him!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Carl) D'you know how bad it looks when you know something that I don't? Never know something that I don't. Now, Carl, where did I put my keys?

Name: Carl
Dialog: (irritably) I don't know.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Looks great, ladies! Everything's going without a hitch!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (offscreen) Hey, hey, hey! I'm Drusselsteinian! I deserve to be here!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: And that sounds like a hitch waiting to happen.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Tasting room is for bakers and emissaries only.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just here to... to help. Yeah, help. D-D-D-Definitely not evil.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What are you doing here, Dr. Doofenshmirtz?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Um... (clears throat) have we met?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, wait, I got it! I got it! Are you my dentist?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What? No! You seriously don't remember me?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (voiceover) We borrowed your spaceship and traversed an alien planet?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: First of all, it's a Galactic-Travel-inator, not a spaceship.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We even did that whole song sequence together?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, did it go a little something like...

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yes!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: The emissaries are here! Mitzy!

Name: Mitzy
Dialog: You! Leave now!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I wanted to help with the baking process.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: No, thanks! This Baking Patch ain't for nothin'! (gasps)

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: This is perfect place for festival, ja? Which is very disappointing, hmm? All festivals in Drusselstein are set four miles west of the perfect place to put them.

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: Hmmm. Shriveled Man not shriveled enough.

Name: Emissary 3
Dialog: And where Droogy, dancing mascot? I prepay for meet-and-greet!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Well, I think you're going to love the droogen strudel we made.

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: I fast for weeks for this tasting of droogen strudel.

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: I missed my child's birthday for this.

Name: Emissary 3
Dialog: I missed my own wedding!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You've got this, Isabella!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Turn coming! Everybody lean left!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Your left or doonkelberry left?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is the same direction!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You shoulda been more clear!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No, no, Buford... Aww. Looks like we're taking the scenic route!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus, you're just in time! Let's squeeze in a quick ride while I monologue.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, pull on the yellow tab.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha haaaa, you're trapped! Anyway, you know that feeling when you think you're biting into a delicious, gooey chocolate chip cookie, but (gasps) it's actually a gross oatmeal raisin cookie instead? That... That's how I feel about droogens. Seriously. Droogens have a very discouraging flavor. I left Drusselstein just to get away from that stuff.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) My tragic childhood and all those backstories, I could put up with that stuff. But droogens? That is where I draw the line.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I digress. E-Every day I digress. I go off-topic and just ramble... Look-look-look, I'm doing it right now. Right now, I'm digressing! Anyway, behold! My Droogen-Chocolate-swap-inator! With this, I'll swap out all the droogens in a one-mile radius for chocolate! Then all those little droogen lovers will finally know my pain— (Perry escapes his trap) Whoa, hey! Tampering with the yellow tab is a safety viola—

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Okay, this droogen strudel is going to knock your rockenhosen off!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Taste my bitter dark chocolatey wrath!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh, wai-wai-wait, these droogens look awfully chocolatey. Does that mean... (Doof tastes a piece of Shriveled Man's legs.) Mmmm! (He tastes some more.) Oh, this Shriveled Man is chocolate! The droogens are gone! I'm... My plan worked! Whoa! What is this weird feeling? Is this getting a win? 'Cause I'm gonna get used to this!

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: (clears throat) What went wrong?

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: (spits) It tastes like chocolate! Is not dry or discouraging at all!

Name: Emissary 3
Dialog: (spits) Where are the droogens?

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: No contract for you! We return to Drusselstein.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, that's our stuff!

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: You waste our time, we take your stuff. Mmhmm.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: But we followed the recipe to a T! What went wrong?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It worked, Perry the Platypus! It worked!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, I'm sad to report that our trade agreement with Drusselstein has failed. It looks like we'll have to sell off one of our state areas. Now it's time to panic.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Sell a state area? That just leaves a Bi-State Area! I'm not taking over some lousy Bi-State Area! Oh! (to Emissary 2) Please don't cancel the contract! You're making a big mistake!

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: No droogen strudel, no contract.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (to Perry) Errgh, this is all your fault! If you hadn't broken my inator, I could reverse all this! Listen, I'm gonna go try to fix the droogen strudel, you go stall those emissaries.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You, too? So it wasn't just me. All the droogens in the festival are now chocolate.

Name: Man
Dialog: Chocolate?! This is a lot less discouraging!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, dentist girl!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I don't know what you want, but I don't have time.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm not here to beef. We need new strudel and I'm here to help.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: "Help?" You? Tchh. You couldn't even remember who I am.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I remembered who you were, but I pretended not to cuz last time we worked together, you showed me up a little and... B-But right now, you are the only one who could make a good droogen strudel. So, will you work with me? For the good of the Tri-State Area? Please?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (sighs, shakes Doof's hand) Okay. But if we're doing this, we're doing it Isa-style! We're making the ultimate droogen strudel. The biggest one they've ever seen!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ooh! Sounds like you're going to need a big oven. I can take care of that! (leaves)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Now we just need droogens! But they've all turned to chocolate.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did somebody say, "Droogens"?

Name: Buford
Dialog: We got this big doonkelberry...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: ...and we saw what happened to the festival.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Uh, we could build a device to concentrate sunlight and dry the doonkelberry instantly.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Perfect! Come on, girls! And pharmacist.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: We've got some droogen strudel to bake!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: This song montage is taking longer than I thought. I hope those emissaries haven't left yet.

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: Hurry up, prepare to depart.

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: Wait! It cannot be!

Name: Emissary 3
Dialog: Droogy! The dancing droogen! His dried, discouraging antics have delighted me since I was wee child!

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: Hmmm. Let us hold briefly to enjoy this marvel.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: How's it comin', Phineas?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: World's largest droogen coming right up!

Name: Fireside Girls
Dialog: Ooooh!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ready the jackhammers!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Nice! Now to get it toasted!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Is this what eating feels like? Ding! Now I have experienced the whole cycle of digestion!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It looks good, but will it hold up to the taste test?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Oh, no!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, it's authentic. I just still hate droogen.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I seriously hope I never have to work with you ever again.

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Um, how are we going to get this to the emissaries? It could be a real transportation logistics problem.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, it's a good thing I drove here in two trucks attached side by side. (He takes out keys to said trucks.)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Seriously?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Adulting!

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: Well, 45 minutes is enough, ja? Mmhmm. Let us cease our brief holding. (They start to go back on the ship, when a truck horn honks.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Wait! Don't go! We've got one more droogen strudel for you to try!

Name: Emissary 2
Dialog: A droogen strudel of zis size? I haff never seen ze likes before!

Name: Emissary 1
Dialog: (tasting) Mmmm, the droogens are delightfully discouraging!

Name: Emissary 3
Dialog: Dis droogen strudel is acceptable! We shall sign contract!

Name: Roger
Dialog: The Drusselsteinian emissaries have signed the contract! The Tri-State Area shall remain whole!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (wiping away a tear) The dream is back, baby! Y'know, in restrospect, I should never have used my Droogen-Chocolate-Swap-inator in the first place.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What?! You mean this was your fault the whole time?! This isn't over. (She goes over to the Fireside Girls to present their patches.) Okay, ladies. I think we've more than earned these Preventing-an-International-Incident patches.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, what about me? I helped. Do I get a patch, too?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I think the Good-Job-Cleaning-Up-Your-Own-Mess patch suits you perfectly.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Also, I was not joking about mistaking you for my dentist. You guys are really... it's eerie.

Name: Dentist
Dialog: Okay, time for your root canal.

Name: Dentist
Dialog: Ja!
